scores.notes: Both images show the same dry hillside estate with a flat-roofed pale cut-stone house, low stone enclosure walls, olive trees, and terraced rolling hills in the background, seen first from further down the dirt road (left) and then from the courtyard in front of the house (right).

David standing by the brook on the left and kneeling to be anointed by Samuel on the right share the same short curly dark-brown hair, clean-shaven youthful face, fair-warm skin tone, and slender teenage build.

Moses seated on the stone on the left and leading the Israelites between the parted waters on the right are the same elderly man with wavy white hair, a full white beard, weathered features, and matching build.

Jesus crouching by the shore fire on the left and standing before Lazarus's tomb on the right match in shoulder-length dark wavy hair, neat dark beard, facial profile, olive skin tone, apparent age, and slender build.

Jesus standing in the boat on the left and standing on the sea on the right clearly depict the same man in his thirties with shoulder-length wavy brown hair, a neat dark beard, olive skin, and matching facial structure and build.

Both scenes show the same weathered grey-tan clapboard house with a gabled wooden porch, an overarching gnarled tree trunk on the left, and a long white-clothed tea table set with floral teapots and cups, viewed from slightly different distances.

Peter stepping from the boat on the left and lifting the lame man at the temple gate on the right match in short curly salt-and-pepper hair, thick grey-flecked beard, weathered tanned face, middle-aged appearance, and stocky build.

Jesus standing in the boat on the left and crouching by the coal fire on the right share the same shoulder-length dark wavy hair, neat dark beard, facial profile, olive skin tone, apparent age, and slender build.

Alice arguing in the courtroom on the left and drinking from the bottle in the hallway on the right are the same fair-skinned young girl with long light-brown hair, matching childlike facial proportions, apparent age, and slender build.

Moses striking the rock on the left and overlooking the parted Red Sea in three-quarter rear profile on the right share the same medium-long wavy white hair, full white beard, elderly build, and weathered skin tone.

Alice holding the flamingo on the croquet-ground on the left and drinking from the bottle in the hallway on the right are the same young fair-skinned girl with long light-brown/golden hair, matching oval face, apparent age, and build.

Both images plausibly show the same circular cut-stone lion pit at dawn—sharing pale ashlar masonry, a curved stone rim, an iron-banded wooden plank hatch cover, and warm morning light—viewed from the pit floor looking up (left) versus the upper rim with steps descending into the opening (right).

The house architecture and table setup conflict clearly: the left shows a brick-and-stone half-timbered cottage with a bay window, a bare wooden table, an upholstered armchair, and the tree trunk on the right, whereas the right shows a weathered wooden clapboard house with a gabled porch, a white-clothed table, a wooden chair, and the tree trunk on the left.

David dodging Saul's spear on the left and kneeling to be anointed by Samuel on the right share the same short dark curly hair, clean-shaven youthful face, fair-olive skin tone, and slender athletic build.

Alice drinking from the bottle in the dark hallway on the left and crouching as a giant in the courtroom on the right are the same fair-skinned young girl with long wavy light-brown/golden hair, matching facial features, apparent age, and build.

Holmes seated in the train carriage on the left and examining a photograph at his desk on the right are clearly the same lean, clean-shaven middle-aged man with swept-back dark hair, high forehead, aquiline nose, and gaunt cheekbones.

Daniel addressing the king in the banquet hall on the left and climbing the rope out of the lions' den on the right match in short cropped silver-grey hair, trimmed grey-white beard, older facial profile, tanned skin tone, and slender-medium build.

Peter leaping from the boat into the sea on the left and stepping over the gunwale onto the stormy water on the right are the same stocky, weathered middle-aged man with short curly salt-and-pepper hair and a matching grey-flecked beard.

Both images depict the same deep circular pit built of weathered grey-beige ashlar stone blocks with a sandy floor and golden dawn light streaming from above, seen from the upper rim looking down (left) and from inside the pit floor looking up (right).

Jesus calling Lazarus from the tomb on the left and calming the storm from the boat on the right share the same shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair, neat dark beard, facial structure, olive skin tone, apparent age, and slender build.

Holmes standing on the bed swinging a cane on the left and seated at his desk with a magnifying glass on the right are the same tall, lean, clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead, aquiline nose, and sharp gaunt cheeks.

Both show the same single-masted wooden plank fishing boat on the Sea of Galilee surrounded by matching rolling hills on both shores, differing only in the storm-to-calm sky and wave change requested by the two verses.

Both depict the same pebbly shoreline of the Sea of Galilee with a smoking campfire by the water's edge, olive trees and shrubs along the bank, hazy rolling hills across the lake, and an overcast dawn sky, viewed from the boat toward shore (left) and from shore toward the boat (right).

Peter standing in the courtyard on the left and leaping from the boat on the right match closely in short curly salt-and-pepper hair, full grey-flecked short beard, weathered tanned face, apparent age, and sturdy build.

Holmes examining a photograph at his desk on the left and kneeling on the bed swinging a cane on the right are clearly the same lean, clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead, prominent aquiline nose, and gaunt cheekbones.

Holmes seated at his desk on the left and tapping the pavement outside the pawnbroker's in a top hat on the right share the same tall lean build, clean-shaven gaunt face, sharp aquiline profile, and dark hair.

The two scenes show different locations and conflicting foliage and lighting: the left is a country lane right outside the burning white manor surrounded by bare leafless winter trees under a dark stormy sky, whereas the right is a railway station platform looking across bright green fields toward a plume of smoke behind a lush leafy green clump of trees in bright daylight.

Peter stepping from the boat onto the stormy sea on the left and leaping over the side wrapping his cloak on the right share the same short curly salt-and-pepper hair, trimmed grey-flecked beard, weathered tanned face, and muscular stocky build.

Holmes seated in the railway carriage on the left and standing on the iron bed striking at the bell-rope on the right are the same lean, clean-shaven middle-aged man with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead, aquiline nose, and gaunt cheekbones.

The house architecture, tree placement, and table setting all conflict: the left shows a red-brick gabled cottage, a mostly bare wooden plank table, and the tree trunk on the left, while the right shows a pale stucco Georgian house with a classical pedimented porch, a full white tablecloth, and the tree trunk on the right.

Dr. Watson standing in Saxe-Coburg Square on the left (holding his medical bag in a bowler hat) and seated in the armchair on the right share the same solid middle-aged build, thick dark brown mustache, sturdy jaw, and ruddy fair complexion.

Both images show the same dry sandy seabed corridor strewn with shells, rocks, and seaweed, flanked on both sides by towering curling walls of teal-and-white seawater stretching toward the distant desert shore.
Jesus calling Lazarus from the tomb on the left and walking on the moonlit sea on the right share the same shoulder-length dark wavy hair, neat dark beard, apparent age, and slender build.
Both depict the same flat green English garden croquet lawn edged with low shrubs, tall trees, and perimeter hedging/wall under bright pale daylight, seen from different angles across the lawn.

Alice standing before the Caterpillar on the mushroom on the left and drinking from the bottle in the hallway on the right are the same fair-skinned young girl with long light-brown hair, matching oval face, apparent age, and slender build.

Moses seated on the stone on the left and striking the rock with his rod on the right clearly depict the same elderly man with wavy white hair, a full white beard, weathered tanned features, and sturdy build.

Dr. Watson entering the doorway on the left and seated in the armchair examining the battered hat on the right are clearly the same sturdy middle-aged man with neatly parted short brown hair, thick dark mustache, square jaw, and ruddy fair skin.

Both show the same green royal croquet lawn bordered by shrubs, tall broadleaf trees, and a low garden perimeter under pale daytime light, viewed from slightly different directions across the grounds.

Daniel praying in the lions' den on the left and stepping up out of the pit on the right match in short cropped silver-grey hair, neat grey-white beard, older facial features, olive skin tone, and slender-medium build.

Jesus standing in the bow of the boat on the left and standing on the sea on the right share the same shoulder-length dark wavy hair, neat dark beard, olive skin tone, apparent age, and slender build.

Alice seated at the tea table on the left and standing before the Caterpillar on the right are the same fair-skinned young girl with long light-brown hair, matching oval child's face, apparent age, and slender build.

Alice drinking from the bottle in the hallway on the left and standing beside the giant mushroom on the right match closely in long golden-light-brown hair, fair skin, childlike facial features, apparent age, and slender build.

The burning house has clearly different architecture—a wide five-bay Georgian manor with four chimneys and a flat portico on the left versus a smaller three-bay pitched-gable house with two end chimneys and a triangular porch on the right—and the grounds shift from bare leafless winter trees under a dark sky to leafy green trees and rose bushes in brighter daylight.

Peter standing by the courtyard fire on the left and stepping over the boat side onto the waves on the right are the same stocky middle-aged man with short curly salt-and-pepper hair, trimmed grey-flecked beard, and weathered tanned face.

Moses walking between the walls of the Red Sea on the left and striking the rock on the right are the same elderly man with wavy white hair, a full white beard, weathered tanned face, and matching build.
Both images clearly show the same enclosed royal garden croquet-ground with green turf, a low pale stone perimeter wall, shrubs, tall broadleaf trees, and bright overcast daylight.
